Line.DefaultText: Now that you ask, this village dreams bigger than its hands. A proper cottage for a miller: there's a man who'd grind grain for the whole valley if he had a roof over his stones. Another for a weaver, so we stop hauling every bolt of cloth in by cart. And a Village Hall, so the place finally has a heart to gather in. Help raise them, and you'll find this village doesn't forget its friends.
